english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a representative instance or an illustration of a rule.
Use 例子 as the all-purpose noun for one example or occurrence illustrating a general pattern.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for an example or comparison that clarifies an idea.
Use 例子 as the all-purpose rendering for a representative instance or example.
